units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 17a:5">B. Bath. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>שבעה … רמה ות׳</he> over seven persons no kind of worms had power.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:16">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 7</cite> <he>מה הת׳ הזאת וכ׳</he> as the worm has (for its defense) nothing but its mouth, so Israel has nothing but the prayer of his mouth; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:16">ib.</cite> ed. Bub. <he>מה ת׳ מעקרת … מעקרין וכ׳</he> (not <he>מתעקרת</he>, <he>מתעקרין</he>) as the worm uproots the tree, so Israelites, through their mouth and their prayer, undo evil decrees &c.
Midd. II, 5 כל עץ … ת׳ וכ׳ wood in which a worm was found was unfit for the altar; a. e.—שני(ה) ת׳ scarlet-dyed (yarn). Midr. Till. l. c. משכן של ת׳ ש׳ a tabernacle of scarlet yarn.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:10">Par. III, 10</cite> <he>שְׁנִי ת׳</he>; a. e.
